title: China’s Top Spy Chief Warns A.I. Is a Threat to Party Rule
partialText: Even as Beijing urges the United States not to hype the dangers of A.I., its own spy chief is framing the technology as a threat to the Communist Party’s security.

title: Trump Administration Moves to Integrate A.I. Into Medical Care Despite Concerns
partialText: Federal projects are rolling out A.I. agents that offer therapy and prescribe medicine, raising concerns about safety and the influence of venture capital investors.

title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Touches 5%, Highest Level in Years
partialText: One of the world’s most important interest rates hit a level recorded only once since the global financial crisis, as investors continued to rebuff the Trump administration’s efforts to sway the bond market.

title: Bond Market Rebukes Bessent by Sending Borrowing Costs Ever Higher
partialText: The Treasury secretary had dared “Bloomberg terminal bros” to bet against him and they did.

title: Whistle-Blower: Federal Agents May Have Broken State Laws in Search For Voter Fraud
partialText: Agents expressed concern about being directed by top Homeland Security leaders to use private information to look up voter records in state databases.

title: As Supreme Court Weighs Trump Mail Ballot Plan, Another Judge Blocks It
partialText: The ruling by a lower court judge was another blow to President Trump’s effort to make voting by mail harder. The Supreme Court is also considering the Trump plan.

title: The Supreme Court Is Considering Trump’s Mail Voting Plan. Here’s What to Know.
partialText: The administration’s plan to screen mail-in ballots remains blocked as the Supreme Court reviews challenges to new U.S. Postal Service ballot rules.

title: Immigrants’ Lawyers Say U.S. Is Redacting Documents Proving Legal Status
partialText: Many noncitizens need immigration records the government has to prove their legal stay and resist deportation. The government is redacting and withholding those documents, lawyers say.

title: ‘Alligator Alcatraz’ Used Small Cages to Confine Migrants, DHS Watchdog Report Says
partialText: The Department of Homeland Security’s internal watchdog provided new details about conditions at the now-shuttered Florida detention center.

title: Key West Feels the Pain of Trump Decision on Haitians
partialText: The end of legal protections for Haitian immigrants nationally has jolted the labor market in this remote vacation destination in Florida where many live and work.

title: States and Cities Sue Over Trump’s Policy to Restrict Green Cards
partialText: The policy would give immigration officers wide authority to deny green cards to people using public benefits.

title: How to Watch the 2026 Emmy Awards

title: Be the First to Find Out the 100 Best TV Shows of the 21st Century
partialText: Starting Sept. 21, we’ll unveil a list of 100, as voted on by more than 500 television professionals in Hollywood and around the world. Make sure you’re getting updates.

title: Saudi Arabia Faces ‘Worst-Case Scenario’ After Iran’s Attacks and Trump’s Rebuffs
partialText: The kingdom is in a state of strategic shock after coming under attack from an emboldened Iran and failing to win more U.S. military support, analysts say.

title: Saudi Leader Meets U.S. Commander as Houthi Attacks Threaten Oil Markets
partialText: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman asked the United States for more U.S. military help last week after the Iranian-backed Houthi forces in Yemen launched a broad offensive.

title: Bob Mackie, Designer Who ‘Dressed Every Spangly Woman in Show Business,’ Dies at 87
partialText: His sequined gowns and outrageous costumes threw clouds of glitter at American fashion for over half a century.

title: Mahmoud Khalil Says Columbia Failed to Protect Pro-Palestinian Students
partialText: In a federal lawsuit, Mr. Khalil and other former student activists say the university was deliberately indifferent to their harassment even before the 2023 Hamas attacks.

title: ‘I Have a Lot to Say’: Brain Implant Helps a Disabled Patient Speak
partialText: In the latest advance in brain-computer interfaces, a company said its wireless device enabled speech even when a patient just imagined saying words.

title: Taryn Simon’s Giant Exhibition at the Guggenheim Tells the Story of America
partialText: Taryn Simon’s new show at the Guggenheim Museum is an audacious attempt to document the story of modern America through the life of one F.B.I. agent.

title: In Hegseth’s Pentagon, Top Leaders Battle Turmoil
partialText: Persistent distractions are feeding a climate of mistrust as the U.S. military faces a series of wartime issues, including shortfalls of missile interceptors.

title: A Teen Autopsy Marks the Arrival of a Deadly Drug in San Francisco
